name: paint-column-rule-3d
_comment: Same column geometry as paint-column-rule, so the blocks land in the columns the browser uses. Empty page-coloured boxes, so only the rules are ink. The 16px rule splits into 8px halves. groove is dark on the left and light on the right; ridge is the reverse. inset paints as ridge and outset as groove, the collapsing-border treatment Edge uses for a column rule. A solid fill of #6b4c9a would fail. pixel_tolerance 2 matches paint-border-styles.
